title: INVOL Tool � SELFREACC (XXXAC08SR + UN/TK) � Promise Stays at 14-Day Mark � Eligible
description:
Customer's flight was cancelled and the customer self-rebooked via the SELFREACC tool. Identifier: XXXAC08SR (variants) + UN/TK segment status in PNR history. Despite the customer initiating the rebooking action, SELFREACC is classified as INVOL because the rebooking was necessitated by an airline disruption. Promise does NOT update.
